additional_info.subject: On site visit
additional_info.body:
Checked on site router 2 did not respond on ip ping but it had power. Port 7 had connection.
We performed a power cycle and after that the router answered ping. We could also login on the web interface.
Did a reboot and after that the charger was green and working again.
